data.name: Silentia
data.detailed_description:
In Silentia, the monster is blind. It sees only what it hears.


A blind predator stalks these woods, and it hunts by sound alone. In this asymmetric multiplayer horror, one player takes control of Krav while everyone else fights to stay alive and get out. Move in silence and it will never know you're there. Make a sound, and it comes for you.

HUNT AS KRAV

You're blind, and sound is the only sense you have. The survivors are out there, hidden in the dark, and you won't see a single one of them, not until they make a sound. Any noise loud enough flares across your vision as a ripple, pointing you straight to it. And every sound you hear feeds you, making you stronger. So let them run. Let them panic. The more noise they make, the closer they pull you in.

SURVIVE IN SILENCE

To the monster, you don't even exist, not until you make a sound. Sprint, smash something, shout, and a ripple shoots straight to it, giving away exactly where you are. Stay slow, stay quiet, and you stay invisible. Keep your noise under control, get your objectives done, and slip out before you make the one sound that gets you killed. Here, survival comes down to how quietly you can move.

YOUR VOICE BETRAYS YOU

3D proximity voice chat lets you talk to your team, call out threats, and plan your next move, but the monster is always listening. Push your voice too far and your own mic turns into a beacon, drawing Krav right to you. Talking can keep you alive. It can just as easily get you killed.

FIGHT BACK

You're not defenseless. The tools to fight back are scattered across the map. Set up the sonic devices, place them right, and use the monster's own hearing against it. Escaping is one way to win. Putting the thing down for good is another.

LEAVE NO ONE BEHIND

Krav grabbing a teammate isn't the end. Hit it with anything you can throw, a bottle, a brick, whatever's on hand, and the stun forces it to let go. Caught yourself with no one coming? As long as you've still got something to throw, you can free yourself. Just mind your aim, because a bottle drops a survivor just as hard as it drops the monster.

NEVER THE SAME

Objectives, items, and escape routes change every single match. One round you're repairing a car, the next you're getting a boat running, and sometimes it's something else entirely. Whatever it is, you have to pull it off before the monster closes in, and you never know what's waiting until you're already in it.

THE HUNT AWAITS

  • Asymmetric multiplayer horror: one blind monster against a team of survivors, up to eight players per match
  • A sound-based perception system where survivors stay invisible until they make a sound
  • Full 3D proximity voice chat that becomes part of the gameplay itself
  • Fight back and kill the monster, or escape in silence
  • Randomized objectives, items, and escape routes for high replayability
  • Full localization, available in multiple languages

The monster is blind. Don't give it a reason to find you.

data.short_description: In Silentia, the monster is blind. It sees only what it hears. Hunt as Krav, a creature that grows stronger with every sound, or survive as one of the many, escaping in total silence. Make a sound, and it finds you.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Turkish

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD Radeon R7 260x (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Silentia features spatial audio. Use of headphones is highly recommended for the best experience.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device (Spatial Audio support)
  • Additional Notes: Silentia features spatial audio. Use of headphones is highly recommended for the best experience.
